info.name: Sentiment Active Learning API
info.description:
# Sentiment Active Learning API

Complete test collection for the Sentiment Active Learning Spring Boot application.

## Overview
This application classifies movie-review sentiment (POSITIVE / NEGATIVE) using a Naive Bayes model built with Oracle Tribuo. It implements a full active-learning cycle: the model detects its own uncertainty, consults Claude AI as a labelling oracle, and retrains itself automatically.

## Authentication
All endpoints are protected with HTTP Basic Auth. Credentials are stored as environment variables:
- `{{username}}` — Swagger UI username (default: `admin`)
- `{{password}}` — Swagger UI password (default: `admin`)

## Recommended Test Workflow
1. **Health check** — verify the application is running
2. **Seed reviews** — run the `🌱 Seed Data` folder to populate the database (runs 20 requests automatically via collection runner)
3. **Train the model** — `POST /api/model/train`
4. **Submit a review** — `POST /api/reviews` and observe classification
5. **Monitor the cycle** — `GET /api/model/active-learning-status`

## Dynamic Variables
The `POST /api/reviews` request automatically saves the returned `id` as `{{lastReviewId}}`. All subsequent single-review endpoints use this variable automatically.

## Error Envelope
All errors return a uniform JSON structure:
```json
{
  "httpStatus": 409,
  "httpStatusText": "Conflict",
  "errorCode": "MODEL_NOT_TRAINED",
  "message": "The model has not been trained yet."
}
```

exec: // Validates that required environment variables are set
console.warn(`[SAL] Warning: variable '${v}' is not set. Please configure your environment.`);
// Collection-level test: Content-Type is JSON for non-empty responses

item.name: 🏥 Health
item.description: Application health check via Spring Boot Actuator. Use this first to verify the application is running before executing any other requests.

request.description: Returns the health status of the application. Does not require authentication. Expected: `{ "status": "UP" }`

response.name: 200 — Application healthy

item.name: 🌱 Seed Data
item.description:
Run this folder via the **Collection Runner** to seed the database with 20 labelled reviews (10 positive, 10 negative) before training the model.

**How to use:**
1. Click the folder → Run folder
2. All 20 requests run in sequence
3. Then run `POST /api/model/train` to train on the seeded data

item.name: Label All Seed Reviews — Positive Batch

request.description: ⚠️ After seeding, use GET /api/reviews to find the actual IDs and apply labels via PATCH /api/reviews/:id/label for each review. This request is a reminder — update the IDs as needed.

item.name: 📝 Reviews
item.description: Endpoints for submitting reviews for classification, retrieving samples, and managing labels.

request.description: Submits a review for classification. The model classifies it and — if uncertain — consults the Claude AI oracle. The returned `id` is automatically saved as `{{lastReviewId}}` for use in subsequent requests.

exec: // Save the review ID for downstream requests

response.name: 201 — Classified (confident, SEED label)
response.body:
{
  "id": 42,
  "reviewText": "This film was absolutely brilliant. The performances were extraordinary and the direction was flawless.",
  "label": "POSITIVE",
  "labelSource": "SEED",
  "confidenceScore": 0.9412,
  "uncertain": false,
  "createdAt": "2026-03-22T17:45:00",
  "updatedAt": "2026-03-22T17:45:00"
}

response.name: 201 — Classified (uncertain, CLAUDE label)
response.body:
{
  "id": 43,
  "reviewText": "It was... fine I suppose. Not terrible, not great.",
  "label": "NEGATIVE",
  "labelSource": "CLAUDE",
  "confidenceScore": 0.5312,
  "uncertain": true,
  "createdAt": "2026-03-22T17:46:00",
  "updatedAt": "2026-03-22T17:46:00"
}

response.name: 400 — VALIDATION_ERROR (blank text)
409 — REVIEW_ALREADY_EXISTS (duplicate)
409 — MODEL_NOT_TRAINED (no model yet)
502 — CLAUDE_API_UNAVAILABLE (oracle down)

request.description: Returns all review samples in the system regardless of labelling status. Returns an empty array `[]` if no reviews exist — this is the correct REST behaviour for an empty collection.

exec: console.log('[SAL] Total reviews in system:', pm.response.json().length);

response.name: 200 — Reviews retrieved
response.body:
[
  {
    "id": 42,
    "reviewText": "An absolute masterpiece. The performances were outstanding.",
    "label": "POSITIVE",
    "labelSource": "CLAUDE",
    "createdAt": "2026-03-21T17:45:00",
    "updatedAt": "2026-03-21T18:02:00"
  },
  {
    "id": 43,
    "reviewText": "Dreadful from beginning to end.",
    "label": "NEGATIVE",
    "labelSource": "MANUAL",
    "createdAt": "2026-03-21T17:47:00",
    "updatedAt": "2026-03-21T17:52:00"
  }
]

request.description: Returns only reviews that have been assigned a sentiment label (SEED, MANUAL or CLAUDE). These are the samples used for model training.

response.name: 200 — Labelled reviews retrieved

request.description: Returns only reviews that have not yet been assigned a label. These are awaiting classification or manual labelling.

response.name: 200 — Unlabelled reviews retrieved

request.description: Returns the review sample with the given ID. Uses `{{lastReviewId}}` which is automatically populated by the Submit Review request.

response.name: 200 — Review found
response.body:
{
  "id": 42,
  "reviewText": "An absolute masterpiece. The performances were outstanding.",
  "label": "POSITIVE",
  "labelSource": "CLAUDE",
  "createdAt": "2026-03-21T17:45:00",
  "updatedAt": "2026-03-21T18:02:00"
}

response.name: 404 — REVIEW_NOT_FOUND

request.description: Manually assigns a POSITIVE or NEGATIVE label to the specified review. Stored with `labelSource: MANUAL` — the highest-quality training signal. Overrides any existing label.

response.name: 200 — Label applied
response.body:
{
  "id": 42,
  "reviewText": "An absolute masterpiece.",
  "label": "POSITIVE",
  "labelSource": "MANUAL",
  "createdAt": "2026-03-21T17:45:00",
  "updatedAt": "2026-03-22T10:15:00"
}

response.name: 400 — VALIDATION_ERROR (null label)
404 — REVIEW_NOT_FOUND

request.description: Corrects a wrong model prediction. The corrected label is stored with `labelSource: MANUAL` and feeds directly into the next retraining cycle. The optional `feedbackNote` is logged for diagnostics.

response.name: 200 — Correction applied
response.body:
{
  "id": 42,
  "reviewText": "Oh sure, absolutely wonderful if you enjoy watching paint dry.",
  "label": "NEGATIVE",
  "labelSource": "MANUAL",
  "createdAt": "2026-03-22T09:00:00",
  "updatedAt": "2026-03-22T11:30:00"
}

response.name: 400 — VALIDATION_ERROR (null corrected label)
400 — VALIDATION_ERROR (feedback note too long)
404 — REVIEW_NOT_FOUND

item.name: 🤖 Model
item.description: Endpoints for triggering training runs, querying model health statistics, and monitoring the active-learning cycle.

request.description:
Triggers an immediate training run on all currently labelled samples. Under normal operation, retraining is triggered automatically by the active-learning cycle. Use this after bulk-importing seed data.

Set `forceRetrain: true` to bypass the minimum sample threshold check.

response.name: 200 — Training completed
response.body:
{
  "trainedAt": "2026-03-22T16:00:00",
  "samplesUsed": 20,
  "positiveCount": 10,
  "negativeCount": 10,
  "accuracyScore": 0.85,
  "precisionScore": 0.86,
  "recallScore": 0.84,
  "modelSavedToDisk": true,
  "modelStoragePath": "./model/sentiment-model.ser",
  "note": "Manual training run triggered via Postman."
}

response.name: 409 — INSUFFICIENT_TRAINING_DATA

request.description: Forces a training run even if the minimum sample count has not been reached. Useful for development and testing with small datasets.

response.name: 200 — Force training completed
response.body:
{

}

request.description: Returns a snapshot combining live corpus counts from the database with historical evaluation metrics from the most recent training run. If untrained, historical metrics are zero.

exec: console.log('[SAL] Model trained:', stats.trained, '| Total labelled:', stats.totalLabelled, '| Accuracy:', stats.accuracyLastRun);

request.description: Returns the current state of the active-learning cycle: progress towards the next automatic retrain, total completed retraining runs, number of unlabelled reviews awaiting labelling, and model file health.
